svg.title: A pointer and the object it points to
svg.desc: Two variable boxes on the stack. The left box, named altitude_ptr, holds the address 0x7ffd…a04 and itself sits at address 0x7ffd…9f8. The right box, named altitude_m, holds the value 120 and sits at address 0x7ffd…a04. A blue arrow runs from altitude_ptr to altitude_m, labelled points to.
